mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, t.name AS head_teacher_name FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.head_teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.deleted = 0
AND ( (scope.departmentId != null AND c.department_id = scope.departmentId) OR (scope.hasClassIds AND c.id IN #{id}) OR (scope.teacherId != null AND c.head_teacher_id = scope.teacherId) OR (scope.selfOnly = false AND scope.teacherId != null AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student s_scope JOIN score sc_scope ON sc_scope.student_id = s_scope.id JOIN course co_scope ON co_scope.id = sc_scope.course_id WHERE s_scope.clazz_id = c.id AND sc_scope.deleted = 0 AND co_scope.teacher_id = scope.teacherId)) )
AND c.clazz_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{clazzName}, '%')
AND c.grade = #{grade}
ORDER BY c.id DESC
